backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing the backend canister with access control, user profile management, user statistics, and channel status tracking, all gated by role-based authorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three implemented features (Quick Play auto-start, light UI redesign, Tailwind light-theme tokens) to their relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated text file containing one- to two-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their roles in the Global FM React application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app with PWA meta tags, portrait orientation lock (including CSS rotation for landscape), and icon/manifest links.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest for 'Gracy FM Radio Live' defining app name, icons, portrait-primary orientation, standalone display mode, and theme colors.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: GPRS-optimized service worker that caches static assets on install, cleans old caches on activate, and applies network-first for navigation, cache-first for static assets, and network-only for radio streams and external APIs.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that manages global state (selected station, playback, modals) and composes all major UI components including the toolbar, audio player, search overlay, and dashboard.
frontend/src/components/AudioPlayer.tsx: Audio playback component that manages an HTML audio element for streaming radio stations, with play/pause, volume, skip, and auto-reconnect on error.
frontend/src/components/AudioSpectrumAna: Canvas-based audio visualizer that uses the Web Audio API to render a mirrored bar spectrum analyzer with warm coral colors while a station is playing.
frontend/src/components/BlinkingStars.ts: No-op stub component retained to prevent import errors after blinking stars were removed during a light-mood redesign.
frontend/src/components/DonationModal.ts: Modal dialog that displays cryptocurrency donation addresses (USDT, ICP, Bitcoin) with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying copyright info, the author's name, and a referral link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/LoadingScreen.ts: Full-screen loading state component with an animated radio icon, signal rings, and bouncing dots shown while stations are being fetched.
frontend/src/components/PWAInstallPrompt: Bottom banner that intercepts the browser's beforeinstallprompt event and prompts the user to install the app, with a 7-day dismissal cooldown stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/RadioPlaybackDis: Displays the currently playing radio station's info (flag, name, country, tags) with animated playing indicator, share, and bookmark action buttons.
frontend/src/components/RadioTowerOverla: Renders a centered radio tower icon with animated signal-wave rings that only appear when the station is playing.
frontend/src/components/SearchOverlay.ts: A full-screen search overlay that filters the station list by name, country, language, or tags and displays clickable results with flag icons.
frontend/src/components/SpaceScene.tsx: A stub/no-op component that replaced the original space scene background; renders nothing but is kept to avoid import errors.
frontend/src/components/StationCounter.t: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/Tagline.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/TopToolbar.tsx: Fixed top navigation bar with the Global FM brand, station count badge, and action buttons for search, dashboard, donations, refresh, and Internet Identity login/logout.
frontend/src/components/UserDashboard.ts: A modal dashboard panel showing the user's auth status, currently playing station, station stats, and a bookmarks list with toggle support.
frontend/src/components/WeatherModule.ts: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor, invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBookmarks.ts: Hook that manages a list of bookmarked station UUIDs in localStorage, syncing state across components via a custom browser event.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags. Includes an InternetIdentityProvider component that persists identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching radio station data with a multi-layer caching strategy (memory, localStorage, IndexedDB) optimized for low-bandwidth connections. Includes lazy loading, Hindi Christian station fetching, and cache management utilities.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS layers, and defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using OKLCH colors. Also includes utility animations, PWA orientation handling, and scrollbar styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with TanStack QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the DOM root.
frontend/src/serviceWorkerRegistration.t: Handles PWA service worker registration and unregistration, with separate logic for localhost development and production environments. Supports optional callbacks for update and success events.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence helpers. Includes a function to remove sensitive parameters from the URL hash without page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color palettes (coral, warm, peach), custom fonts (Nunito, Poppins), border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations for UI effects.
PACKAGING_GUIDE.md: Documents which files and directories to include or exclude when creating a distributable ZIP package of the Global FM application, and describes packaging methods.
project_state.json: Defines the project state for 'Quick Play Radio', a light-themed radio app, including existing features for quick play, UI redesign to a light/pastel aesthetic, and Tailwind/CSS theme token updates.
README.md: Overview of the Global FM app — a 3D interactive globe with live radio stations built on the Internet Computer using React Three Fiber and Motoko — listing features and project structure.
SETUP_INSTRUCTIONS.md: Quick-start guide for running Global FM locally, covering prerequisites and setup steps.
unknown.txt: A brief support/troubleshooting guide for packaging issues, covering file permissions, relative paths, clean system testing, and exclusion patterns.
